matched_claim.description: YAML loading does not catch UnicodeDecodeError, so a later non-UTF-8 .yaml/.yml file can abort detection even after valid CDI devices were loaded, instead of being skipped like an unreadable JSON file.

a2.note: all claims fully localized; none within tolerance

matched_claim.description: The YAML branch does not catch UnicodeDecodeError (a ValueError, unlike the JSON branch), so now that all files are read instead of stopping at the first, one non-UTF-8 .yaml file in the spec dirs raises out of load_cdi_config and aborts GPU detection.
